review_text: I redeemed my HDFC Flexi Cap fund units after 8 months and noticed almost 1% was deducted as some fee called 'Exit Load'! Why was this not clearly shown on the sell screen? I thought mutual funds had zero withdrawal fees. Very disappointed with Groww.

Hidden charges everywhere. When I withdrew my money after 5 months, an exit load fee of ₹1,450 was cut from my balance. Nobody warned me during redemption that 1 year wasn't completed. Your app must show exit load warnings before confirming order!
Groww interface is very clean for tracking stocks and mutual funds. Dark mode is amazing and charts are smooth.

I switched from one equity fund to another after 6 months and Groww charged an exit load! Why is switching treated as redemption? Support took 4 days to reply and just gave a generic copy-pasted link. Please make fee disclosures obvious.
My Auto-pay mandate failed twice this month even though I had sufficient bank balance. Groww showed payment processing for 48 hours.

Extremely frustrated! Withdrew my emergency funds from large cap fund and lost ₹2,000 to exit load penalty. Why can't the app display 'You will incur 1% exit load if redeemed before 24-Oct-2026' on the sell slider?
KYC re-verification took 3 business days because of Digilocker timeout. Once completed, account activation was seamless.

Why is there an exit load deducted when redeeming mid-cap fund after 9 months? I was under the impression that only ELSS has a lock-in period. Groww support told me 1% applies for < 365 days. Put this prominently on the order screen!
Search bar is quick and one-click SIP setup via UPI is great. Needs better annual capital gains report filters.
SIP amount got deducted from my HDFC bank account on the 5th, but unit allocation took until the 9th. NAV was allocated late.

Was hit with unexpected exit load fee of 1% while taking out funds for a medical emergency after 11 months. Just 20 days more and it would have been 0%! If Groww had a small countdown or banner, I would have waited.
Customer support bot is useless when asking about unexpected charges. It keeps redirecting to FAQ articles instead of connecting to a human agent.
Portfolio rebalancing tools and category breakdown are top notch. Very easy for beginner investors.
Sold some units of flexi cap to pay college fees, got ₹850 deducted as exit load. There is zero transparency on the sell popup about exit loads and applicable cutoff dates.
Had trouble updating nominee details online. Had to submit physical signature form. Please digitize 100% of nominee updates.

Groww promotes mutual funds as zero commission, but then AMC cuts 1% exit load upon redemption! Many novice investors don't know the difference between broker commission and AMC exit loads. Groww must educate users at the time of withdrawal.
SIP pause feature worked well for 2 months while I was between jobs. Resumed smoothly in September.

I was charged an exit load on my ELSS fund... wait, support said ELSS cannot even be redeemed before 3 years, but my flexi cap had an exit load. The terms are so confusing for normal people! Please explain exit load vs lock in clearly.
Ticket #98412 regarding redemption proceeds took 5 days to resolve. Need faster in-app chat response times.
Redeemed partial units after 7 months. Surprise deduction of exit load! Why doesn't the redemption screen show 'Estimated Exit Load: ₹X' before asking for the T-PIN?
Clean UI, fast biometric login, and good fund comparison charts.
Got shocked seeing lesser payout in bank account. Found out it was exit load of 1%. Why doesn't Groww add an alert: 'Hold for 45 more days to save 1% exit load'?
BSE star MF mandate failed occasionally. UPI mandate is much more reliable than net banking.
Exit load was charged on my mutual fund redemption because I missed the 1-year cutoff by literally 12 days! A simple date pill on the portfolio screen would prevent this for thousands of users.
Good app overall. Keep improving the mutual fund tax reports and capital gains statements.
